title: Steady symmetric Navier-Stokes flow near Poiseuille flow: existence and vanishing viscosity limit
summary: We study the existence and vanishing viscosity limit of steady incompressible Navier-Stokes flows in a horizontally periodic strip with no slip boundary conditions and midline symmetric forcing. Taking a Poiseuille flow as the leading order Euler profile, we construct higher order symmetric approximate solutions and establish the existence of a symmetric solution to the associated nonlinear error equation.
